verses.en: Then again Abraham took a wife, and her name was Keturah.
verses.pt: E Abraão tomou outra mulher, cujo nome foi Quetura;
verses.en_web: Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.
verses.en_bbe: And Abraham took another wife named Keturah.

verses.en: And she bare him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.
verses.pt: A qual lhe deu à luz a Zinrã, e a Jocsã, e a Medã, e a Midiã, e a Jisbaque, e a Suá.
verses.en_web: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
verses.en_bbe: She became the mother of Zimran and Jokshan and Medan and Midian and Ishbak and Shuah.

verses.en: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.
verses.pt: E Jocsã gerou a Seba, e a Dedã: e filhos de Dedã foram Assurim, e Letusim, e Leummim.
verses.en_web: Jokshan became the father of Sheba, and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.
verses.en_bbe: And Jokshan became the father of Sheba and Dedan. And from Dedan came the Asshurim and Letushim and Leummim.

verses.en: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abidah, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
verses.pt: E filhos de Midiã: Efá, e Efer, e Enoque, e Abida, e Elda. Todos estes foram filhos de Quetura.
verses.en_web: The sons of Midian were: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
verses.en_bbe: And from Midian came Ephah and Epher and Hanoch and Abida and Eldaah. All these were the offspring of Keturah.

verses.en: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.
verses.pt: Mas Abraão deu tudo quanto tinha a Isaque.
verses.en_web: Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac,
verses.en_bbe: Now Abraham gave all his property to Isaac;

verses.en: But unto the sons of the concubines, which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.
verses.pt: E aos filhos de suas concubinas deu Abraão presentes, e enviou-os para longe de Isaque seu filho, enquanto ele vivia, até o oriente, à terra oriental.
verses.en_web: but to the sons of Abraham’s concubines, Abraham gave gifts. He sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, to the east country.
verses.en_bbe: But to the sons of his other women he gave offerings, and sent them away, while he was still living, into the east country.

verses.en: And these are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived, an hundred threescore and fifteen years.
verses.pt: E estes foram os dias de vida que viveu Abraão: cento e setenta e cinco anos.
verses.en_web: These are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived: one hundred seventy-five years.
verses.en_bbe: Now the years of Abraham's life were a hundred and seventy-five.

verses.en: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.
verses.pt: E expirou, e morreu Abraão em boa velhice, ancião e cheio de dias e foi unido a seu povo.
verses.en_web: Abraham gave up his spirit, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.
verses.en_bbe: And Abraham came to his death, an old man, full of years; and he was put to rest with his people.

verses.en: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;
verses.pt: E sepultaram-no Isaque e Ismael seus filhos na caverna de Macpela, na propriedade de Efrom, filho de Zoar Heteu, que está em frente de Manre;
verses.en_web: Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre,
verses.en_bbe: And Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, put him to rest in the hollow rock of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, near Mamre;

verses.en: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.
verses.pt: Herança que comprou Abraão dos filhos de Hete; ali foi Abraão sepultado, e Sara sua mulher.
verses.en_web: the field which Abraham purchased of the children of Heth. Abraham was buried there with Sarah, his wife.
verses.en_bbe: The same field which Abraham got from the children of Heth: there Abraham was put to rest with Sarah, his wife.

verses.en: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahai-roi.
verses.pt: E sucedeu, depois de morto Abraão, que Deus abençoou a Isaque seu filho: e habitou Isaque junto a Beer-Laai-Roi.
verses.en_web: After the death of Abraham, God blessed Isaac, his son. Isaac lived by Beer Lahai Roi.
verses.en_bbe: Now after the death of Abraham, the blessing of God was with Isaac, his son.

verses.en: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s handmaid, bare unto Abraham:
verses.pt: E estas são as gerações de Ismael, filho de Abraão, que lhe deu à luz Agar egípcia, serva de Sara:
verses.en_web: Now this is the history of the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s servant, bore to Abraham.
verses.en_bbe: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, the son of Abraham, whose mother was Hagar the Egyptian, the servant of Sarah:

verses.en: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
verses.pt: Estes, pois, são os nomes dos filhos de Ismael, por seus nomes, por suas linhagens: O primogênito de Ismael, Nebaiote; logo Quedar, e Adbeel, e Mibsão,
verses.en_web: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to the order of their birth: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
verses.en_bbe: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael by their generations: Ishmael's first son was Nebaioth; then Kedar and Adbeel and Mibsam

verses.en: And Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,
verses.pt: E Misma, e Dumá, e Massá,
verses.en_web: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,
verses.en_bbe: And Mishma and Dumah and Massa,

verses.en: Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:
verses.pt: Hadade, e Tema, e Jetur, e Nafis, e Quedemá.
verses.en_web: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
verses.en_bbe: Hadad and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:

verses.en: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.
verses.pt: Estes são os filhos de Ismael, e estes seus nomes por suas vilas e por seus acampamentos; doze príncipes por suas famílias.
verses.en_web: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments: twelve princes, according to their nations.
verses.en_bbe: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names in their towns and their tent-circles; twelve chiefs with their peoples.

verses.en: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died; and was gathered unto his people.
verses.pt: E estes foram os anos da vida de Ismael, cento e trinta e sete anos: e expirou Ismael, e morreu; e foi unido a seu povo.
verses.en_web: These are the years of the life of Ishmael: one hundred thirty-seven years. He gave up his spirit and died, and was gathered to his people.
verses.en_bbe: And the years of Ishmael's life were a hundred and thirty-seven: and he came to his end, and was put to rest with his people.

verses.en: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur, that is before Egypt, as thou goest toward Assyria: and he died in the presence of all his brethren.
verses.pt: E habitaram desde Havilá até Sur, que está em frente do Egito vindo a Assíria; e morreu em presença de todos os seus irmãos.
verses.en_web: They lived from Havilah to Shur that is before Egypt, as you go toward Assyria. He lived opposite all his relatives.
verses.en_bbe: And their country was from Havilah to Shur which is east of Egypt: they took their place to the east of all their brothers.

verses.en: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son: Abraham begat Isaac:
verses.pt: E estas são as gerações de Isaque, filho de Abraão. Abraão gerou a Isaque:
verses.en_web: This is the history of the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son. Abraham became the father of Isaac.
verses.en_bbe: Now these are the generations of Abraham's son Isaac:

verses.en: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padan-aram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.
verses.pt: E era Isaque de quarenta anos quando tomou por mulher a Rebeca, filha de Betuel arameu de Padã-Arã, irmã de Labão arameu.
verses.en_web: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan Aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian, to be his wife.
verses.en_bbe: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Aramaean of Paddan-aram, and the sister of Laban the Aramaean, to be his wife.

verses.en: And Isaac intreated the LORD for his wife, because she was barren: and the LORD was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
verses.pt: E orou Isaque ao SENHOR por sua mulher, que era estéril; e aceitou-o o SENHOR, e concebeu Rebeca sua mulher.
verses.en_web: Isaac entreated Yahweh for his wife, because she was barren. Yahweh was entreated by him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
verses.en_bbe: Isaac made prayer to the Lord for his wife because she had no children; and the Lord gave ear to his prayer, and Rebekah became with child.

verses.en: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, why am I thus? And she went to enquire of the LORD.
verses.pt: E os filhos se combatiam dentro dela; e disse: Se é assim para que vivo eu? E foi consultar ao SENHOR.
verses.en_web: The children struggled together within her. She said, “If it is so, why do I live?” She went to inquire of Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And the children were fighting together inside her, and she said, If it is to be so, why am I like this? So she went to put her question to the Lord.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto her, Two nations are in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people; and the elder shall serve the younger.
verses.pt: E respondeu-lhe o SENHOR: Duas nações há em teu ventre, E dois povos serão divididos desde tuas entranhas: E um povo será mais forte que o outro povo, e o maior servirá ao menor.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to her, “Two nations are in your womb. Two peoples will be separated from your body. The one people will be stronger than the other people. The elder will serve the younger.”
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to her, Two nations are in your body, and two peoples will come to birth from you: the one will be stronger than the other, and the older will be the servant of the younger.

verses.en: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.
verses.pt: E quando se cumpriram seus dias para dar à luz, eis que havia gêmeos em seu ventre.
verses.en_web: When her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.
verses.en_bbe: And when the time came for her to give birth, there were two children in her body.

verses.en: And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.
verses.pt: E saiu o primeiro ruivo, e todo ele peludo como uma veste; e chamaram seu nome Esaú.
verses.en_web: The first came out red all over, like a hairy garment. They named him Esau.
verses.en_bbe: And the first came out red from head to foot like a robe of hair, and they gave him the name of Esau.

verses.en: And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau’s heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.
verses.pt: E depois saiu seu irmão, pegando com sua mão o calcanhar de Esaú: e foi chamado seu nome Jacó. E era Isaque de idade de sessenta anos quando ela os deu à luz.
verses.en_web: After that, his brother came out, and his hand had hold on Esau’s heel. He was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them.
verses.en_bbe: And after him, his brother came out, gripping Esau's foot; and he was named Jacob: Isaac was sixty years old when she gave birth to them.

verses.en: And the boys grew: and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a plain man, dwelling in tents.
verses.pt: E cresceram os meninos, e Esaú foi hábil na caça, homem do campo: Jacó porém era homem quieto, que habitava em tendas.
verses.en_web: The boys grew. Esau was a skillful hunter, a man of the field. Jacob was a quiet man, living in tents.
verses.en_bbe: And the boys came to full growth; and Esau became a man of the open country, an expert bowman; but Jacob was a quiet man, living in tents.

verses.en: And Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison: but Rebekah loved Jacob.
verses.pt: E amou Isaque a Esaú, porque comia de sua caça; mas Rebeca amava a Jacó.
verses.en_web: Now Isaac loved Esau, because he ate his venison. Rebekah loved Jacob.
verses.en_bbe: Now Isaac's love was for Esau, because Esau's meat was greatly to his taste: but Rebekah had more love for Jacob.

verses.en: And Jacob sod pottage: and Esau came from the field, and he was faint:
verses.pt: E cozinhou Jacó um guisado; e voltando Esaú do campo cansado,
verses.en_web: Jacob boiled stew. Esau came in from the field, and he was famished.
verses.en_bbe: And one day Jacob was cooking some soup when Esau came in from the fields in great need of food;

verses.en: And Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom.
verses.pt: Disse a Jacó: Rogo-te que me dês a comer disso vermelho, pois estou muito cansado. Portanto foi chamado seu nome Edom.
verses.en_web: Esau said to Jacob, “Please feed me with that same red stew, for I am famished.” Therefore his name was called Edom.
verses.en_bbe: And Esau said to Jacob, Give me a full meal of that red soup, for I am overcome with need for food: for this reason he was named Edom.

verses.en: And Jacob said, Sell me this day thy birthright.
verses.pt: E Jacó respondeu: Vende-me neste dia tua primogenitura.
verses.en_web: Jacob said, “First, sell me your birthright.”
verses.en_bbe: And Jacob said, First of all give me your birthright.

verses.en: And Esau said, Behold, I am at the point to die: and what profit shall this birthright do to me?
verses.pt: Então disse Esaú: Eis que vou morrer; para que, pois, me servirá a primogenitura?
verses.en_web: Esau said, “Behold, I am about to die. What good is the birthright to me?”
verses.en_bbe: And Esau said, Truly, I am at the point of death: what profit is the birthright to me?

verses.en: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.
verses.pt: E disse Jacó: Jura-me hoje. E ele lhe jurou, e vendeu a Jacó sua primogenitura.
verses.en_web: Jacob said, “Swear to me first.” He swore to him. He sold his birthright to Jacob.
verses.en_bbe: And Jacob said, First of all give me your oath; and he gave him his oath, handing over his birthright to Jacob.

verses.en: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.
verses.pt: Então Jacó deu a Esaú pão e do guisado das lentilhas; e ele comeu e bebeu, e levantou-se, e foi-se. Assim menosprezou Esaú a primogenitura.
verses.en_web: Jacob gave Esau bread and stew of lentils. He ate and drank, rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright.
verses.en_bbe: Then Jacob gave him bread and soup; and he took food and drink and went away, caring little for his birthright.
